title: COMP Generator Shortcuts Page
summary: Official Derivative generator COMP Shortcuts page for parent shortcuts, global OP shortcuts, and internal OP shortcut/path pairs.
guidance: Use this article as the generator COMP version of the same shortcut contract: parent shortcut local to the component, global shortcut accessible anywhere, and internal shortcut pointing at an internal OP.
Prefer scoped parent or internal shortcuts unless project-wide global access is required.
